requirements.text: Detailed programme per module: objectives, prerequisites, outline and active methods (at least 50% practical exercises).
Groups of 12 trainees maximum in person and 8 in virtual classes.
Trainers with at least 5 years' experience in the field and experience with local authorities; CVs supplied.
End-of-course evaluation and 3-month follow-up evaluation; report sent for each purchase order.
Prior placement test (online) for office-software modules.
Named disability contact; materials and arrangements adapted on request.
In-house sessions at the buyer's premises or remote; set-up within 4 weeks of the purchase order at most.
Materials supplied in an accessible digital format, reusable internally by the buyer.
Three references of training for local authorities over the last 3 years.
“Psychosocial risks and conflict management” module adapted to local public services.
Training-provider activity declaration number to be supplied.
Individual end-of-training certificate given to each trainee.
BPU: price per day (in-house) and per trainee (open course); annual DQE simulation per lot, quantities unchanged.

company_desc: programmes, trainer CVs, evaluation procedures, references

chunks.title: Programme — Spreadsheets and collaboration tools for public staff (2 days)
chunks.text: Objectives, prerequisites and hour-by-hour outline. 60% of the time on practical exercises from real municipal cases (budget tracking, team rota, dashboard). Materials and corrected exercises handed out at the end.

chunks.title: Programme — Preventing psychosocial risks and managing conflict
chunks.text: 2-day module for front-line managers: spotting weak signals, difficult conversations, mediation. Case studies from local public services (reception, technical services).

chunks.title: Tool — Online placement test
chunks.text: 20-minute test sent 10 days before the session; balanced groups in 3 levels; results shared with the buyer's training department.

chunks.title: Procedure — End-of-course and follow-up evaluations
chunks.text: End-of-course questionnaire, 3-month follow-up questionnaire for the trainee and their manager. Summary report sent for each purchase order.

chunks.title: CV — Thomas Lemoine, lead office-software trainer
chunks.text: Thomas Lemoine (fictional person): 11 years training office software and digital tools, work with around forty local authorities, lead trainer for lot 1.

chunks.title: CV — Sophie Arnaud, management and prevention trainer
chunks.text: Sophie Arnaud (fictional person): 14 years' experience, 8 with local authorities, in front-line management and psychosocial-risk prevention.

chunks.title: Commitment — Disability contact and adapted materials
chunks.text: Disability contact reachable before each session; materials (large print, audio), pace and arrangements adapted at the trainee's or buyer's request.

chunks.title: Organisation — Setting up in-house and remote sessions
chunks.text: Groups of 12 trainees maximum in the room and 8 in virtual classes. Average set-up time observed: 3 weeks after the purchase order (fictional internal figure). Equipment lent if needed.

chunks.title: Charter — Accessible digital materials
chunks.text: Materials supplied as accessible PDF and editable files, with an internal reuse right for the client's own staff.

chunks.title: References — Local authorities trained (2024–2026)
chunks.text: Port-Brumeux town (fictional): 18 office-software sessions. Haut-Brumeux community of communes (fictional): managers' pathway. Brume water syndicate (fictional): conflict prevention. Contacts supplied.

chunks.title: Training-provider activity declaration
chunks.text: Activity-declaration receipt (fictional number for the demo), attached to every application.
